commit_message: Add transient Game View camera override
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0126 Timeline first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues ADR 0126 first-release implementation by adding a runtime-only Game View camera-selection override shared by renderer, temporal history, LOD, camera-relative movement, and lock-on. Timeline composition will arbitrate stable camera-cut bindings into this neutral runtime resource without mutating persisted Camera3D enabled/priority fields.

Draft PR remains intentionally unmerged pending full ADR 0126 completion and validation.
